items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I remember those guys, Coleman Simpson; a mandolin player, he was called Jackfish

ctx.x: -- because it was so pretty, you know? Beautiful! And I remember those guys, Coleman Simpson; a mandolin player, he was called Jackfish, tall, 6'3" or 4". He was that tall, and he was good, sharp all the time. And most of the time -- I can
see them now wearing those derby hats and shoes shined to perfection. I mean their suits pressed.
